overview: A mobile-first portfolio tracker with glassmorphic dark UI for monitoring net worth, asset allocation, and passive income across NGN and USD. Features live price feeds, volatility heatmap, and demo data mode.
features: Internet Identity silent sign-in with per-user data isolation
Demo data mode with $50k pre-loaded portfolio and Nigerian bank alerts
NGN/USD currency toggle using live exchange rates
Asset allocation donut chart (Stocks, Crypto, Cash)
Volatility heatmap with Fortress (blue) vs Growth (pulsating orange) assets
Passive income tracker with auto-calculated annual yield %
12-month net worth line chart with Total Gain/Loss badge
Live price feeds via HTTP outcalls (Twelve Data, CoinGecko)
In-app risk alerts and portfolio rebalancing warnings
